items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: His name was Scotty. He played with the Missourians and I played there for that season.

ctx.x: had money, they were farmers somewhat and they liked the jazz that we were playing.
His name was Scotty. He played with the Missourians and I played there for that season. Then, as I said, I decided to make an act.

Well, I went to Montreal to see what was happening for a week or two and there was a place called Rockheads,... Mountain Street, / and they had a band at that time. They always had bands though, and they used American talent. Singles, and all the fellows in the band, they were ex-Americans, most of them, they had children with Canadians.
